scope_decision.reason: Villa Maija (https://hangofarm.fi/loma-asunto-hanko/hotelli-villa-maija-hanko) is a clearly bounded single Accommodation product: one restored 1888 historic villa building containing 4 named apartments (Eastside, Southside, Westside, Upperside) sharing one address, one management company, and one booking system (villamaija.guestybookings.com). However, the same site's 'Muut kohteet' page (https://hangofarm.fi/loma-asunto-hanko/vuokra-asunto-hanko) lists 16 additional, individually named apartments/villas at different street addresses across Hanko (e.g. Villa Rosa, Serenity Suite, Villa Granit View, Hangon Herttua, etc.), each with its own distinct Guesty booking property ID, capacity, and amenity set, managed by the same company (Hangö Farm / C&E Rosenberg Oy) but not sharing a single physical building or address with Villa Maija or each other. These are not room types or seasonal packages within one product -- they are separate physical rental properties, so this constitutes multiple candidate Accommodation products under one domain. No single source resolves which one property should be 'the' Accommodation record for this run. Villa Maija was retained as the extracted product because it is the most completely documented single-building candidate with its own dedicated page; the other 16 are preserved as alternatives and must not be merged into Villa Maija's fields.

product.summary: Villa Maija: a fully renovated (2022-2023) 1888 historic villa in Hanko (Appelgrenintie 7, 10900 Hanko), operated by Hangö Farm (C&E Rosenberg Oy), offering 4 furnished short-term-rental apartments (Villa Maija 1 Eastside, 2 Southside, 3 Westside, 4 Upperside) that share one booking system (villamaija.guestybookings.com) and one shared terrace. Open year-round.
